ns2:course.label: Convergence Design II
ns2:course.description: Environments: At the overlap of theatre, architecture, and media are a growing number of convergent environments and alternative spaces. This course expands on the elements of convergence design with a strong focus on the design and installation of light for the built environment, from theatres to casinos to museums. 3 undergraduate hours. 4 graduate hours. Prerequisite: THEA 231, THEA 423, THEA 431.
